notes: Incidence of Suicides in States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities

The incidence of suicides for the States as a whole recorded a decline of 3.5 percent in 1976 over 1975. Out of 22 States, 10 States recorded a decline in suicide cases and the remaining 12 States registered an increase. J & K recorded the maximum increase (2350.0 percent) followed by Sikkim (200.0 percent), Meghalaya (44.8 percent), Rajasthan (39.9 percent) Andhra Pradesh (24.4 percent), Punjab (18.6 percent) Haryana (16.6 percent), Maharashtra (10.1 percent), Gujarat (9.7 percent), Bihar (5.7 percent), Tripura (3.9 percent) and West Bengal (0.7 percent). The States which recorded a decline in the incidence of suicides were Nagaland (70.6 percent), Uttar Pradesh (61.8 percent), Himachal Pradesh (18.7 percent), Kerala (15.8 percent), Orissa (14.7 percent), Karnataka (9.5 percent), Manipur (8.3 percent), Madhya Pradesh (6.6 percent), Tamil Nadu (0.4 percent) and Assam (0.2 percent).
